note: Set A binds most values to the right members — the (1) 2-1/4" heavy hex nut, keeper plate used during craning, W8X10 beam, pin connection plate PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 and the 11'-4" T.O. steel — with only two clear misbindings (L3X3X1/4 labeled a column cap plate with a stitched-together quote, and C3X6 labeled an angle). Set B does capture a few facts A omits (1/2" neoprene pad, 2-1/4" A36 threaded rod with up to 12" elevation difference, 3/4" plate, C5 scale), but it makes more substantive errors: it invents a 3/8" weld size, misreads PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 as 1/2" thick and 1" long, puts the threaded rod in Detail A3 instead of B1, and binds PL 6X6X1/4 / L3X3X1/4 to the diagonal brace and HSS4X4X1/4 to a bracing member. A is padded with vague "component | dimension" entries and duplicates, but its claims are more often true and correctly bound, so it is the better set.
